privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AnyDoc is built to collect almost nothing. This page describes exactly what does and does not happen when you use it. It is a first draft pending review and is not final legal advice.
privacy.noAccountsBody: You do not need an account to use the editor. We do not ask for your name, email address, or any other personal details, and there is no sign-up flow.
privacy.noTrackingTitle: No cookies, no tracking, and a local draft you control
privacy.analytics: Run analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts. There are no analytics SDKs, no error-tracking SDKs, and no tag managers in the app.
privacy.offDevice: Send your documents, or any part of them, off your device.
privacy.draftBody: The one exception is crash recovery. If autosave is enabled (the default), your most recent unsaved draft — the document bytes plus annotations, form fields, placed images/text and OCR results — is stored in this browser's IndexedDB. It is never transmitted, it is deleted after 48 hours, and it clears when you save or close the document cleanly.
privacy.draftControl: You can turn autosave off or delete the draft immediately from the Local draft control in the editor.
privacy.draftEncryption: Bản nháp mặc định được lưu không mã hóa trong trình duyệt này. Bạn có thể bật mã hóa tùy chọn bằng cụm mật khẩu (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM) trong điều khiển Bản nháp cục bộ. Cụm mật khẩu và khóa dẫn xuất không bao giờ rời khỏi tab này và không có ký gửi khóa: nếu quên cụm mật khẩu, bản nháp không thể khôi phục.
privacy.draftLimit: Khôi phục sau sự cố giới hạn 20 MB mỗi tài liệu. Tài liệu lớn hơn không được sao chép vào bản nháp; tự động lưu tạm dừng và báo rõ thay vì thất bại âm thầm.
privacy.hostingBody: Our hosting provider may retain standard connection-level logs — IP address, timestamp, and user agent — as part of normal infrastructure operation. We do not use these logs to identify or profile visitors. We are disclosing this rather than claiming zero logging; the exact retention period depends on the host and will be confirmed with whichever host we deploy to.
privacy.noSellTitle: We don't sell or share data
privacy.noSellBody: We do not sell or share data with third parties. There are no analytics SDKs in the app, so there is no visitor data to sell or share.
privacy.childrenBody: AnyDoc is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will look into it.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or data requests, email
privacy.changesBody: This policy may change. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of AnyDoc. They are a first draft pending review and are not final legal advice.
terms.asisBody: AnyDoc is provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the app, including lost, corrupted, or unrecoverable documents.
terms.autosaveBody: Autosave keeps a local crash-recovery draft in this browser, but it is not a substitute for saving. If you close or reload the tab without downloading your changes, unsaved edits can still be lost. Save or export your work before leaving.
terms.acceptableIllegal: Do not use AnyDoc to process illegal content.
terms.acceptableAbuse: Do not abuse the app or attempt to degrade it for other people, including attempts to circumvent rate limits, scrape the service, or send automated traffic that harms availability.
